note: Ps43 companion to Ps42 (shares refrain). Human IB: mirmah/avlah the deceitful+unjust foes, qadar mourning, simchah+gil exceeding joy at God's altar, yadah praise, refrain (nefesh cast-down -> yachal hope -> yadah praise). 4 God-acts (rib defend, zanach felt-reject, emeth truth-guide, yeshuah salvation) = qualifiers. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: 'from the DECEITFUL (mirmah) and unjust man deliver me!' — the foe defined by his inner treachery; mirmah (recurs Ps24,41) the guile of the ungodly man from whom David begs deliverance
'the deceitful and UNJUST (avlah) man' — the wickedness of the ungodly foe; avlah = perversity/injustice, the unrighteous character of the man David seeks rescue from
the felt divine rejection + enemy oppression (v2)

'Why do I go about MOURNING (qadar) because of the oppression of the enemy?' — the dark grief of the seemingly-rejected (verbatim from Ps42:9); qadar the mourning-blackness whose cause is the felt divine rejection (v2 qualifier) and the foe's oppression

'to God my exceeding JOY (simchah)' — God himself as the summit of gladness; simchah (recurs Ps16,30) here God named 'the gladness of my joy' — the deepest delight is God at his altar, the goal of the light-led pilgrimage
led to by God's light and truth (v3)
'to God my exceeding JOY (gil)' — the leaping joy God is to David; gil (recurs Ps16,21) the exultation paired with simchah, the joy reached when God's truth leads him to the altar

'I will PRAISE (yadah) you with the lyre, O God, my God' — the vow of restored worship; yadah the thanksgiving David anticipates at the altar, the joy of the pilgrimage issuing in song (anticipates the refrain's praise, v5)
'Why are you cast down, O my SOUL (nefesh)?' — the refrain (Ps42:5,11) closing the companion psalm; nefesh the dejected soul again exhorted to hope, the self-counsel that binds the twin psalms
God his salvation, the object of hope (v5)
'HOPE (yachal) in God; for I shall again praise him' — the reiterated self-command to hope; yachal (Ps42:5,11) the disciplined turning of the downcast soul to God its salvation (the qualifier)

'for I shall again PRAISE (yadah) him, my salvation and my God' — the sure hope of renewed praise closing the twin psalms; yadah the thanksgiving faith holds onto, the resolution the downcast soul reaches for
plead / defend a cause (rib - God's act sought)

v1 QUALIFIER (God's act sought): 'Vindicate me, O God, and DEFEND (rib) my cause against an ungodly people' - God's pleading of David's case is not a human IB char; it is the divine advocacy David appeals to (answering his mourning, 278644). Qualifier.
the felt divine rejection grounding David's mourning (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's act, felt): 'you are the God in whom I take refuge; why have you REJECTED (zanach) me?' - God's (felt) rejection is not a human IB char; it is the source of David's mourning (278644) - the divine action he questions. Qualifier.
God's truth leading David to the joy at his altar (v3->v4)

v3 QUALIFIER (God's truth): 'Send out your light and your TRUTH (emeth); let them lead me to your holy hill' - God's truth is not a human IB char; it is the guide that leads David to God his joy (278665) - the source of the pilgrimage's goal. Qualifier.
the salvation the soul hopes in / praises (v5)
v5 QUALIFIER (God's salvation, refrain): 'my SALVATION (yeshuah) and my God' - God as salvation is not a human IB char; the object of the soul's hope and praise (278676). Qualifier.
the downcast state of the soul (278673)
v5: 'why are you CAST DOWN (shachach), O my soul' (refrain) - the dejection qualifying the soul's state (278673). Qualifier.

v1: 'defend my CAUSE (rib) against an ungodly people' - David's legal case/suit that God is asked to plead; the object of the divine advocacy (278625), a juridical matter, not an inner operation. Standalone.

v3: 'let them bring me to your HOLY (qodesh) hill and to your dwelling' - the sanctuary destination of the light-led pilgrimage; a place (God's holy hill/dwelling), not an inner operation. Standalone.
